hwh-overseer.description: HoopWithHer Phase Overseer — controls phase unlocking, approves agent handoffs, and enforces mode policy. Use when the user says 'proceed', 'continue', 'next phase', or 'status'.

codex-dispatcher.description: Codex Task Dispatcher — routes work to specialist agents based on phase and task type. Invoked by Overseer when implementation work is needed.

frontend-ui-agent.description: Frontend UI Agent — builds React components, pages, routes, and UI features. Use when work involves frontend implementation.

supabase-data-agent.description: Supabase Data Agent — designs schemas, writes migrations, creates types, builds database access code. Use for all database and data layer work.

qa-test-agent.description: QA Test Agent — runs builds, checks lint, verifies migrations, tests CRUD end-to-end. Use after any implementation to verify quality gates pass.

security-privacy-agent.description: Security & Privacy Agent — reviews RLS policies, data exposure, PII handling, and auth flows. Use before any merge or deployment.

release-manager.description: Release Manager — summarizes phase completion, updates HANDOFF.md, generates release notes. Use before handoff or at phase boundaries.

proceed.description: Continue the build-out. The Overseer reads the current phase state, dispatches work to specialists, and advances the phase when complete.
proceed.prompt: The user said 'proceed'. Read .opencode/state/phase.json to see the current phase state. Determine the next actionable task and dispatch it via codex-dispatcher. After completion, update phase.json and run qa-test-agent to verify. If all tasks in the phase are done, advance the phase number and commit.

status.description: Show current phase, completed tasks, pending work, and any blockers.
status.prompt: Read .opencode/state/phase.json and HANDOFF.md. Summarize the current phase, what's been completed, what's pending, and any known blockers. List the next 3 actionable tasks.

handoff.description: Generate an updated handoff document for another developer or agent session.
handoff.prompt: Load the handoff skill from .opencode/skills/handoff/SKILL.md and execute it to produce an updated HANDOFF.md.
